bio: We'll give you one guess as to what makes Phởholic a much-talked-about spot. Yes, it is the pho, and it's the reason why everyone flocks to this Westminster original (two other locations also lure slurpers). It's a classic shop that attracts everyone from grandparents to Gen Z'ers, all here to partake in the beef-focused pho. Though the prices are gentle, the kitchen never skimps, using only high quality products. Diners take their pick of noodle style and meat from the beginners and adventurers menus, then wait for the large metal bowls of steaming comfort to arrive. The scent of anise fills the air, while the sweet broth soothes the soul. If ordering from the Holic menu, prepare to leave stuffed beyond expectation....
